name: Perplexity
billing: Perplexity API usage is pay as you go. Check project credits and the selected API/model’s token, search or request fees; a consumer subscription does not establish API credits.

steps.title: Choose your API project
steps.body: Sign in to the Perplexity API Console using the official guide and select the project your application will use.

steps.title: Create a project API key
steps.body: Open the console’s API Keys page, create an application key and store it privately on your machine.

steps.title: Choose a compatible text model
steps.body: Review project billing and select a model supported by Prism’s text provider. This verification is a short text request, not the separate deep research workflow.
